purpose: Teach: 後世/頭部/低音/女子大/無能/野望/処女/侮辱

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、後世に教訓を残す事件を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: The police will be handling this case—one that will leave lessons for future generations, won't they?
lines.style: Measured, slightly formal. Thoughtful cadence. Ren is testing whether the officer will engage with the philosophical weight of the situation. Genuine curiosity, not sarcasm.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、頭部の打撲傷を鑑識されますね
lines.en: The police will examine the head trauma forensically, of course.
lines.style: Professional, direct. Officer Takeda answers the substance without dwelling on philosophy. Steady, matter-of-fact tone. A slight nod in his voice—acknowledging the question, moving forward.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、低音域の脅迫電話を、警察、分析されますね
lines.en: The police will analyze those threatening phone calls—the low-pitched voice especially, won't they?
lines.style: Careful, methodical. Ren leans into the technical detail as a way of staying grounded. Slow pace. Watching the officer's reaction.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、女子大キャンパス内の事件にも対応されますね
lines.en: The police will respond to incidents on the women's university campus too, I imagine.
lines.style: Even tone, slightly weary. Officer Takeda is confirming scope without elaborating. A professional acknowledgment that the case branches in multiple directions.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、無能上司のパワハラ事案を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: This case involves workplace harassment by an incompetent superior—the police are handling that aspect as well, aren't they?
lines.style: Quieter now. Ren's tone carries an undercurrent of personal recognition. Not accusatory, but the words land differently. Slightly prolonged on the difficult words.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪者の野望をプロファイリングされますね
lines.en: The police will profile the suspect's ambitions too, naturally.
lines.style: Brief, professional. Officer Takeda returns to procedural certainty. No inflection—just steady confirmation of what the investigation entails.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、処女作公開時のセキュリティを、警察、担当されますね
lines.en: The police will handle security around the release of the suspect's first work—that's part of the response, isn't it?
lines.style: Deliberate, almost careful. Ren is circling something difficult without naming it directly. Slight hesitation before 'first work.' Testing whether Officer Takeda understands the implication.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、侮辱罪の摘発もされますね
lines.en: The police will also pursue charges for defamation, I expect.
lines.style: Clipped, final. Officer Takeda closes the loop. A single nod in his voice. The conversation has moved through its necessary territory.
